theme: Ordinary tides plus the storm that is coming
title: Tide Plus Surge -- forecasting the storm the calm log cannot show you
strategies: trivial: predict T only (ignore surge entirely) -> reproduces the checker's own baseline, ~0.1

greedy: ordinary least squares fit y = a + b*T + c*S on the calm training rows; near-perfect on calm data (kappa*T*S is swamped by noise there, so nothing in the training residuals ever motivates it) but the plain additive sum over-predicts whenever the held-out storm surge coincides with a high tide

strong: kappa cannot be learned from the calm log, but it does not need to be -- it is handed to you directly as a bathymetry survey constant; emit T + S - kappa*T*S using the given kappa rather than discarding it as a column with no training-time leverage

headroom above strong: model the residual sensor-noise-limited fit more precisely (e.g. blend a small correction for the calm surge driver's own harmonic shape) to push held-out MSE further toward the noise floor
